name: SeeSomething_7
short_caption: The robot tilts its head forward with widened eyes to closely examine something, then returns to neutral.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot tilts its head slightly forward and downward while opening its eyes wide in a focused, attentive stare. This forward-leaning head posture is held for a few seconds to simulate looking at something close by. Finally, the robot smoothly raises and centers its head back to the default neutral standing pose.
safety_notes: The movement is confined entirely to a minor head tilt, posing no safety concerns.
